chapter: Hiatus, Blues Walk and the road
title: Starting his own tours, booked by Warren Stevens
summary: He began touring from New York to California, booked partly by Warren Stevens.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now, in ‘55 and ‘56, even though you weren’t recording, you were working.
Were you starting to tour the country, go outside New York by that time?
Right. I had my own tour.
I don’t know exactly the date, but I got my own tour from New York to California.
Who was booking you at the time?

Well, I was booking a lot of the gigs, but another guy named Warren Stevens, who used to work for Ruth Bowen Booking Agency... He’s a guitar player himself. He was a good friend of mine from Columbus, Ohio. He starts booking it.
